Episode 232. Awakening (2)
A golden aura wrapped around Jin's body.
Blinded by the bright light, Phaelito shielded his eyes with one hand, gritting his teeth. His magic was solidifying due to the sacred aura.
"Queen..."
Phaelito tried to push his sword further to stab Lani. However, the sword was firmly stuck in Jin's heart and didn't move at all.
Jin held the blade with his right hand.
'What kind of power is this, from someone who should be considered dead already!'

Phaelito, who had previously overpowered even Hedojo with his full strength, couldn't shake off Jin's grip on his sword. Even when he pulled all his strength, his face distorted, but the Basukala didn't budge.
The right arm of Jin, which had previously lost all feeling and stiffened like stone, was regaining its original form, enveloped in a golden aura.

Even his severed left arm and other wounds were regenerating in the same way. His once hazy eyes were regaining their strength, and his ashen, cold body was filled with a warm vitality. The dark blood that had been flowing from his heart was quickly subsiding.
It seemed like Jin was being resurrected.
Phaelito, shivering at this horrifying realization, tried to remove Basukala with all his might. He gripped the handle with both hands and pulled, punched Jin's face and chest, even bit his neck.
"Argh!"
But none of his attacks affected Jin. Instead, it was Phaelito who felt the pain of his fists and teeth being crushed.
Thud…!
Soon, Jin pulled out the Basukala that was stuck in his body. In the process, Phaelito exploded his magic several times, but he was the only one who was bounced back along with the sword.

Phaelito, pinned to the ground, looked up in a daze. Floating a step above the ground, Jin was looking down at him expressionlessly. He looked as if he had completely recovered, as if he had never been wounded in the first place.
The entire sky was dyed in the golden aura emanating from him. Only the blinding, terrifying scenery met his gaze, and Phaelito hurriedly braced himself for an attack.
However, Jin didn't seem to want to immediately attack him. The situation had reversed in an instant.
"Jin, I'm sorry. All I, and the kingdom, can do... is delay your demise."
Lani said, as she slumped down. Jin turned around to look at her.
Lani's body was gradually becoming transparent as she gasped for breath. It seemed like she would soon completely disappear.
She couldn't fully resurrect Jin.
Lani shed tears of regret and frustration at this fact. Even though Ayula had sent all the remaining divine energy, and the entire kingdom prayed fervently, they couldn't revive Jin.
Soon, Lani would also face extinction.
"It's enough. So, wait until the fight is over."
Lani tried to respond that she couldn't, that this was a farewell, but soon disappeared. Instead, where she was, there remained a mass of light that couldn't originally exist.
That was something not even Ayula, who sent Lani here, could have anticipated. Jin couldn't take his eyes off the light for a while.
And Phaelito thought Jin was in pain. He must be despairing from the pain of losing a loved one right before his eyes.

"Puhu... Ayula, it seems the dreadful immortal has given up himself to postpone your death. But you failed to protect again. A bug, equivalent to an immortal and his avatar that even Lord Zito fears, met their end together. Are you saying that you're worth that much? To the extent that Ayula gives up all her powers!"
Phaelito's malicious voice was hardly heard by Jin.
He was focused. What was the nature of the light left in place of Lani, and when he had come across it before.
He didn't need much time.
'Sword Emperor Star.'
The void space where Gliek had engulfed him and Ron during the Sword Emperor Star incident.

Jin had encountered this light there too. The moment when Ron Hairan, who had fallen into the demon world, broke through the chaos and reached the realm of creation. That moment when he finally overcame the chaos.
Back then, Jin had just encountered the light, but since it was not the creation, he could not see it with his own eyes. He was only aware that Ron had shared some of that light with him to save him.
It's clear.
Unlike then, Jin could now stare at the light of creation with both eyes. He could tell that the wall that had been blocking that light had disappeared.
'The light of creation...'
He has imagined it countless times since his previous life.
The moment he reaches the creation, the moment he stands at the top of the world like his father, Jin thought about it every day.
However, the great thrill he had imagined did not come.
Just because he became the creation doesn't mean all problems are solved. Since some point, for Jin, the creation was not the ultimate goal as an immortal, but a means necessary to fulfill his dream.
To end all those madmen who threaten his life, people, the world, and step into peaceful days.
Thus, shake off all the sense of debt he had to the world as a returnee, and put an end to the long struggle that has continued since his previous life.
Becoming the creation is an essential process for that.
After a long time, he overcame a big mountain. Jin turned his body again, leaving the light that remained in Lani's place as it was.
It was then that Phaelito realized.
"Ah... you... you're... in the same realm with me... Isn't this just a temporary power gained from receiving Ayula's energy?"
"It's true that Ayula postponed my extinction through Lani. But the fact that I woke up as soon as I was about to die seems to be something that even Ayula didn't know."
Fate, Phaelito could only think of that word.
'Really, is the fate of being a returnee... at the top of all other fates? Is it dare to say that a mortal, especially a human, has it?'
Then Phaelito could never defeat Jin. The fate given to Phaelito would surely be lower than that.
It was unfair.
He had been able to overwhelm Jin's party without ever being in crisis and could have taken his life several times.

The difference in fate seemed to force defeat. It seemed that fate was saying that no matter how strong you are, whatever you do, you can't defeat Jin Runcandel. Even if Jin admitted defeat and knelt down, it seemed that fate would not allow it.
Jin saw through that thought.
"That would have been the case."
"...What did you say?"

"If the Sun God had continued to exist in this world, or if the order of suffering you guys have been claiming had been applied to the world. There would have been no means for you to beat me. Because it's against the order."
Jin, slowly approaching Phaelito.

"But the ground you're stepping on now is not such a terrible world, Phaelito. There's nothing fixed... anomalies can happen anywhere, and the result can change at any time. That's the world we know, the order we know."
"Shut up!"
Kwang!
Phaelito rushed and struck Bascara. Jin easily broke his posture while repelling his sword.
"Ugh!"
"You might not understand what I'm saying now. You guys are using evil to bind yourselves. That's why Zito is obsessed with order. He probably wants to enjoy pain safely without struggling."
"I said shut up!"
Heuak!
Phaelito gasped. His body was vibrating from the unexpected shock of blocking Jin's sword. A suddenly flying sword grazed his forehead and cut his upper arm before he could blink.
Phaelito was unable to respond at all to the sudden counterattack. As if the majesty of the sword horse, which tore the sky and parted the earth in one stroke, was all a lie.
"It was not just because Jin had ascended.
It was because Shimma had swallowed up Phaelito. If Phaelito had been like this from the start, Jin's party would have easily subdued him.
"Phaelito Belgacium, how did you end up like this?"
Phaelito didn't have the leeway to respond. As he reached out his sword, Jin was looking at Phaelito's shadow.
Thanks to the insight of ascension, he faintly saw Phaelito's past encapsulated within. The image of Phaelito leading the resistance before being brainwashed by Zito.

"You were a fighter for sure. Unlike me, even without the sense of debt as a reincarnator, you were a person who fought for the world. Back then, you must have held the brightest will in the demonic world. There would have been countless people who followed that light."
Jin felt admiration for Phaelito of that time.
He felt a sense of kinship, a desire to fight together, and the thought that he could entrust his back to him, no matter how short the time they had known each other.
But the monster straining now was not that person.
"Kwaaaa....!"
"I may have felt you from that time, but I cannot forgive you."
Swoosh-!
Bradamante cut through Phaelito's left arm. Phaelito's left arm fell to the ground and dispersed into particles.
It was thanks to the faint remaining sense of ascension that he had. Without it, it wouldn't have been his arm but his neck that fell.
Like Jin just before, Phaelito was continually shoved somewhere, spitting up blood.
Occasionally, the authority of the demons imbued in Bascara blocked Jin's path. But no plague or curse could threaten Jin.
The spirit energy that had been blocked by Bascara returned.
Darkness spread between the golden aura that changed after ascension. Phaelito wanted to avoid the light and darkness anywhere, but he was surrounded on all sides.

"You've killed too many people. Brainwashing can't be an excuse. No matter how radiant you were, even if you saved billions of your fellow beings from Zito. If you end up becoming a monster, you meet someone like me and get cut."
Suddenly, Phaelito felt a wall at his back. The curtain of spirit energy blocked his retreat like a giant tube.
People will never forget the massacre and destruction committed by Phaelito after today. His glorious past will never excuse his sins.
But if Zito dies, there might be people in the underworld who will honor Phaelito. Jin thought as he looked down at Phaelito.
He held a black bead in his hand while sticking Bascara into the ground.
'...A soul bead?'
Jin immediately recognized what had formed the bead. It was a bead that Kelliark had given to Phaelito."
